why: EGM behaviour can change under a passing suite when a dependency moves. These are the revisions every measurement in this repository was taken against. A run record cites them; the runbook checks them before a validation run against a real machine.

libsas.howItIsHeld: QSP declares libsas as FetchContent 'sas' at tag v5.4.4.57 and that declaration is not ours to edit. The M0 preset overrides it with FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_SAS, pointing the build at the checkout at C:/Progetti/libsas, which must be at this commit and clean.

nvramArrangement.note: A machine master-resets memory not written in the arrangement it was built for. These fixtures are arrangement 7, which is the QSP the M0 preset fetches. The read-only checkout at C:/Progetti/QSP is arrangement 6 and must not be used as the build source.
